environment: Playwright Chromium; isolated synthetic storage; mocked provider HTTP and delivery transports
interpretation: Automated wall time, includes setup/assertions; not human usability time.

journeys.scenario: AUTH-01 — register, inspect identity, sign out and sign in
AUTH-02 — reject bad login, reload session, sign out and isolate the next user
AUTH-03 — deny private deep links and author actions across accounts
COURSE-01 — create metadata and two manual outlines then reopen each
COURSE-02 — rename, reorder, remove and add outlines without losing activities
COURSE-03 — edit metadata, cancel deletion, then delete and reopen old URL
COURSE-04 — discover by search, difficulty and sort, recover empty results
COURSE-05 — generate selected AI outlines, append and persist editable lessons
MODULE-01 — edit Markdown, preview, reject empty title and persist learner rendering
MODULE-02 — add, edit, reorder and remove flashcards with saved learner order
MODULE-03 — edit quiz options and answer key then verify learner scoring
MODULE-04 — configure practice, execute, reload and explicitly remove it
MODULE-05 — generate activities, cancel then append, refine and save
STUDY-01 — read content, run embedded code and rerun changed code
STUDY-02 — flip and persist every card including the final card
STUDY-03 — rate cards, filter and retain personal ratings
STUDY-04 — incomplete quiz is blocked, score 50%, retry and persist 100%
STUDY-05 — practice output, errors, timeout, reset, solution and saved code
STUDY-06 — complete first module, resume, finish and reload 100% course
PATH-01 — create a goal, edit its details and reload the empty path
PATH-02 — add owned and discovered courses as references, reject duplicate membership
PATH-03 — reorder references, cancel/remove course and cancel/delete path
PATH-04 — discover, follow, reload selected list then unfollow without deleting
PATH-05 — study a selected multi-course path and retain weighted personal progress
SHARE-01 — publish, discover and study, unlist then restore private access
SHARE-02 — grant a named learner, deny outsider, revoke and deny bookmarked access
SHARE-03 — share a path without implicitly granting its private course
SHARE-04 — source changes reach reused paths and deletion leaves unavailable reference
SHARE-05 — reuse counters reflect distinct active references and deletion decrements
STATS-01 — real reading sessions group by inactivity and leave rolling week
STATS-02 — same-day repeats, consecutive dates, gap and historical longest streak
STATS-03 — started course and selected paths differ from ownership and completion
STATS-04 — activity and scores survive navigation, login and account isolation
AI-01 — default Anvil needs no personal key and generated content persists
AI-02 — save secondary Anvil model and use it after reload without changing other users
AI-03 — validate each external provider, persist choice and generate with zero app debit
AI-04 — replace and remove credential, explicitly return to Anvil and generate
AI-05 — unavailable and malformed generation retain draft, retry once with one debit
SUPPORT-01 — persist notification preferences, validate phone and report unavailable transport
SUPPORT-02 — mobile navigation, keyboard tabs/dialogs and missing-route recovery
WORKSPACE-01 — goal, reviewable plan, first draft, explicit apply and study survive reload
WORKSPACE-02 — mixed new and explicitly reused courses preserve original authorship
WORKSPACE-03 — quiz-only revision, study, reload and restore preserve attempts and other content
WORKSPACE-04 — a baseline edit in a second tab rejects stale apply and keeps the proposal
